title: Screen Guild Theater
paragraphs: A Hollywood anthology in which major film stars performed condensed radio versions of movies and other dramatic stories, with the program closely associated with fundraising for the Motion Picture Relief Fund.
Hollywood dramatic anthology built around condensed performances/adaptations of motion pictures and related dramatic material. GRH contains 364 dated recordings through June 1, 1952.

The run breaks into several distinct periods: CBS initial era (January 8, 1939 to June 28, 1948) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], NBC/Camel era (October 7, 1948 to June 29, 1950) on [[org|org.f2f0561f0ce2ddc5|NBC Radio Network]], ABC hour era (September 7, 1950 to May 31, 1951) on [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], and Final CBS era (December 13, 1951 to June 30, 1952) on [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]].

Names that turn up again and again in the surviving run include Bill Lawrence (director and transcriber), Harry Cronman (radio adaptor), Basil Adlam (music director), Basil Adlam and His Orchestra (performer), Bill Davidson (announcer), [[person|jack-oakie|Jack Oakie]] (performer), and Joseph Kearns (performer).

Across its run, the surviving broadcasts are tied to [[org|org.0d7b5c86680811cc|ABC Radio Network]], [[org|org.cd82fd99edb39caa|Armed Forces Radio and Television Service]], [[org|org.8480b75bc0c36e4b|CBS Radio Network]], and [[org|org.a3129b8eb67efa37|KECA]].
The stories often return to Dixieland music and Quiz shows.
The show also sits in a wider radio history that includes Hollywood film adaptation on network radio, Motion Picture Relief Fund fundraising, and Sponsor and audience shift toward television.

If you are following the same actors and creative circles, related programs worth opening next include [[show|lux-radio-theatre|Lux Radio Theatre]], [[show|screen-directors-playhouse|Screen Directors Playhouse]], [[show|yours-truly-johnny-dollar|Yours Truly, Johnny Dollar]], [[show|the-whistler|The Whistler]], and [[show|academy-award-theater|Academy Award Theater]].
